description: Update a product's name, description, delivery link/note, or (one-time products only) price. USE THIS to set delivery_url when a product was created without one — that's how buyers receive what they bought (shown on the thank-you page and receipt). Subscription prices can't be edited (renewals bill the original price) — create a new product instead.

delivery_note.description: Short instructions shown with the access button

delivery_url.description: Where buyers access this product — download URL, course/members login, or booking link (https only)

name: update_product
title: Update product
